title: useActionData
summary: Read the result of a navigating page action.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Optionally pass a typed route object or an action function type generic.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Fetcher action results belong to fetcher.data and are not returned here. Navigating to another route clears page action data. The hook does not submit anything; use Form or router.submit.
